newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 15.

text.p: The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) rejected a government request to resume grant aid to China. The LDP, however, agreed on sending a mission to China this month to negotiate on providing yen loans in the current fiscal year.

The government's tax commission plans to advise the government to levy taxes on a wider range of profit-making operations run by non-profit organisations, such as private schools and religious groups.

Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd applied to the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications for approval to cut international call charges. As a result KDD expects annual revenues to fall 9.3 billion yen, or 5.1 percent.

Construction Ministry will increase the fiscal 1996-97 budget allocation to the Housing Loan Corp to 13.9 trillion yen from the current 10.6 trillion yen. The rise translates into an extra 150,000 mortgages on top of the current 630,000.
